oracle.algorithm: solve (Z'Z+diag(0,1/phi,1/phi)) b=Z'y on Z=[1,x1/s1,x2/s2] (s_j = population SD of parent j, intercept unpenalized); phi=0.2; coefficients b_j/s_j; sigma from the n data-row residuals with n-3 degrees of freedom (no prior pseudo-rows)
oracle.independence_basis: Gaussian elimination over Fractions on the normal equations of the standardized design with the stated ridge penalty; the data are rebuilt from the fixture's formulas. It imports no Antecedent code and calls no BVAR routine. Floating point enters only through the sines and cosines of the inputs, the two population standard deviations and the final residual-scale square root. The data formulas, phi, the intercept-unpenalised convention and the n-3 divisor are fixture statements shared with the product input.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original NumPy harness was not retained; this replacement was written during this review from the fixture's algorithm text. No product implementation source was consulted. It reproduces the stored NumPy values to the fixture's 3e-10.

reference_review.scope: One n=90, two-parent Minnesota-style fit; intercept, both slopes and the residual sigma recomputed exactly and compared at the test's 3e-10.
